retrieved.title: Meraven-61
retrieved.text:
Meraven-61, also known as "Meraven-61," was a grouchy Eleoran navitech automaton that served in the Valovek Coalition. The navitech automaton was stationed in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4 where it excelled at ground maintenance in order to compensate for a programming glitch that meant it was afraid of flying, meaning it was not assigned starfighter duty. In 1 BCE, the automaton was in one of the temple's hangars on several occasions when the criminal Galiven Zeleris passed through.

## Biography

Meraven-61, nicknamed "Meraven-61," was an Eleoran navitech automaton that served in the Kelaenor Group of the Valovek Coalition based in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4. One of dozens of Oriadan Automatics's Ororis-series navitech automatons in the base's automaton labor pool, Meraven-61 had a programming glitch that made it afraid of flying. As such, the automaton was not assigned starfighter duty, but excelled at ground maintenance to compensate for its shortcomings.

In 1 BCE, Meraven-61 was stood in one of the Belanor Sanctuary's hangars when the criminal Galiven Zeleris was escorted through the room by a member of the Valovek Coalition's military police. Soon after, the Eleoran unit was stood with fellow navitech Loreoven-68 beside a Valaedan-97 Daroran-wing starfighter in the hangar when Zeleris was led back through by Valovek Coalition Intelligence Service agent Captain Valiaris Feniris before they departed for the moon Pelitor. Sometime later, Meraven-61 was stood in the mouth of the hangar as Zeleris and Feniris boarded the stolen Helevekian cargo shuttle Keleris Voyager in order to travel to the planet Galidan.

## Characteristics

retrieved.title: Helaetor-20
retrieved.text:
Helaetor-20 (Helaetor-20) was an Meralin-48 navitech automaton belonging to Valovek Coalition Captain Peliasil Pelosil, an evacuation officer assigned to Nelamir Base on the Coresil Frontier ice planet Loraetor during the Pelomon Civil War. Specially programmed to plot sublight tactical courses for starships, Helaetor-20 played an invaluable role during the Battle of Loraetor in 3 ACE by assisting Pelosil in planning evacuation routes from Nelamir Base.

## Biography

Helaetor-20, or Helaetor-20, was a member of the Meralin-48 navitech automaton line, which proved to be commercially unsuccessful but was nonetheless in high demand during the Pelomon Civil War for use in combat starships. By 3 ACE, Helaetor-20 was owned by and served alongside Valovek Coalition Captain Peliasil Pelosil, a popular and charismatic evacuation officer stationed at Nelamir Base, the Valovek Coalition High Command headquarters on the Coresil Frontier ice planet Loraetor.

Helaetor-20 was present inside Nelamir Base's central hangar, chirping melodiously, when Captain Eleoris Beleven returned from conducting a routine scouting mission of the base's exterior with Commander Feneotor Valaesil, who ultimately went missing after falling prey to an ambush from a native ithaenoran ice creature. The navitech automaton passed in front of Beleven's path as the latter made his way through the congested hangar.

During the Battle of Loraetor, Helaetor-20 played a small but pivotal role in helping the Valovek Coalition successfully evacuate Nelamir Base in the face of overwhelming Helevekian assault. Specially programmed to plot sublight tactical courses for space travel, Helaetor-20 proved extremely valuable by coordinating plans, providing tactical support to Pelosil, and planning evacuation routes from the base during the battle.

## Characteristics

retrieved.title: Coreoran-76
retrieved.text:
Coreoran-76 (or Coreoran-76), also known as Coreoran-76, was a Talaran medical assistant automaton in service to the Valovek Coalition around the time of the Battle of Loraetor.

## Biography

Coreoran-76 was stationed in the Valovekans secret Nelamir Base on the ice planet of Loraetor. He assisted both Human and automaton medics in the Nelamir Base medical lab. The automatons ability to use its twenty retractable manipulator arms simultaneously proved useful to an understaffed medical bay. After the loss of Belanor Sanctuary, the Valovek Coalition used any outmoded equipment they could find. This automaton was certainly classed as outmoded but proved invaluable for its sophisticated medical, diagnostic and procedural programming. Although this automaton was capable of speech, its speech synthesizer card was missing.

Coreoran-76 assisted Ralinor-16 on Loraetor after Feneotor Valaesil was attacked by a ithaenoran. The automatons built up a good rapport with one another, and had worked together for more than a year. Despite this, Ralinor-16 would often state his superiority over his medical assistant, due to his egotistical automaton personality.

Coreoran-76 and Ralinor-16 escaped Loraetor aboard the Galumon-66 medium transport Galaelin Promise, the last transport to leave the planet. After the bounty hunters Quelaelin-93 and Fenianor Helaran rescued the passengers of the Galaelin Promise, including the two medical automatons, Coreoran-76 was reassigned to the Oredan-B escort frigate Belaemon Crest.

retrieved.title: Keleoran-76 analysis automaton
retrieved.text:
The Keleoran-76 analysis automaton, also known as Keleoran-76 unit, was a model of analysis automaton characterized by its amplified optical receptors, cranial sensory ridges. They also had mouth-stalk like speech modules, which were fully functioning and occasionally featured articulated metal 'lips.' Unlike the modified Keleoran-ISC units, the regular Keleoran-76s did not have any full-body plating and frequently required irradiation cleanings.

## Description

Keleoran-76 analysis automatons were 1.4 meters tall, closely resembling the Elulin-36 worker automaton, although their heads were a far more complex piece of technology. This superficial similarity belied their intelligence and capability. Keleoran-76 units had triple-digit hands. They worked directly with organics and regularly partnered with the Selemir-32 units, acting as an interface with the rest of the team. They could also be found running various security stations across the Temple. In these stations, they processed the information coming from camera feeds, audio pickups and data streams while they watched the footage for intruders of any description, both physical and digital. The Keleoran-76 units then passed this information to their designated team leader for further analysis or to a Nelivekari.

The Keleoran-76s were known to be dogged, unimaginative and slow and were criticized for being unable to make intuitive leaps. It may have been unfair, though also adept and efficient, as Keleoran-76 units were viewed as being 'just' automatons. However, more experienced Keleoran-76 units later began to make those 'intuitive' judgements–or at least appeared to make them. In hospitals across the galaxy, Keleoran-76 units along with other analysis automaton models, analyzed medical data, particularly in the field of infection control.

## History

retrieved.title: Orulin-53
retrieved.text:
When Beleran-55 attempted to file a report against Orulin-53's disruptive behavior, the form disappeared, causing Beleran-55 to suspect the navitech automaton had destroyed it. Later, Beleran-55's companion Lorialen-51 agreed to switch uniforms with them in hopes of thwarting Orulin-53's antics. However, the automaton was still able to single out Beleran-55 and run over their foot. Orulin-53 was even emboldened enough to threaten Beleran-55 with its arc welder, forcing the trooper to hand over the food they had gathered from the cafeteria before throwing it out the trash compactor. Beleran-55 would detail each of the incidents with the navitech in their log.

The day of the Valovek Coalition attack on the Kelaelen Promise II, Orulin-53 chased down Beleran-55 while the trooper was collecting equipment. As Beleran-55 fled, Orulin-53 attempted to shut the doors they were fleeing through. When Beleran-55 eventually hid inside an escape pod, Orulin-53 pushed the launch button, looking on as the helpless trooper was sent flying into the chaos of the space battle.

retrieved.title: Daremir-56
retrieved.text:
Daremir-56 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton that served as part of Pelomir Squadron in the Valovek Coalition during the Pelomon Civil War against the Helevek Dominion. It flew with Valovekan pilot Quelumon Dareris, and the pair were stationed at the moon Lorumon 4's Belanor Sanctuary.

In the Battle of Lorumon, Pelomir Squadron were deployed to try and destroy the Helevekian Kelaelen Promise superweapon and flew in a Valaedan-B Daroran-wing starfighter. The Valovek Coalition's Daroran-wing starfighters were at first used to draw away fire from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing assault starfighter/bombers of Feneonor Squadron by engaging enemy Pelenor-54 space superiority starfighters or turrets. After most of the bombers were destroyed, Dareris and Daremir-56 were part of an attempted attack run on the Kelaelen Promise's vulnerable thermal exhaust port; however, they were both killed during the run by the Helumonari Lord Quelelen Valaesil.

## Biography

Daremir-56 was the designation of an Orasil-44 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics. During the Pelomon Civil War between the Valovek Coalition and the Helevek Dominion, it served in the Valovek Coalition's Kelaenor Group, which was based out of their headquarters in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4. The navitech automaton flew with the Valovekan pilot Quelumon Dareris as Pelomir Three in the Valovek Coalition Starfighter Corps' Pelomir Squadron.

When the Helevek Dominion's Kelaelen Promise superweapon arrived in the Lorumon system, Daremir-56 and Dareris completed their pre-flight checks together then launched with the rest of Pelomir Squadron in order to try and destroy the battle station before it could obliterate Lorumon 4. The Pelomir Squadron starfighters were tasked with drawing fire away from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing assault starfighter/bombers of Feneonor Squadron, who made an attack run on the Kelaelen Promise's one weakness: its thermal exhaust port

retrieved.title: Dareoran-93
retrieved.text:
> "I'm Dareoran-93, at your service. This way please." ―Dareoran-93 greets the Nelivekari

Dareoran-93 was a Seledan-34 protocol automaton with feminine programming stationed aboard the Heleoris Trade League Daradan-class battleship Beleotor Promise.

## Biography

> "What? What did you say?" "The ambassadors are Nelivekari Knights, I believe." ―Talaris Lorelin and Dareoran-93

Dareoran-93 was a Ithiaven Cybernetics Seledan-34 protocol automaton, part of a special lengthy production run that introduced new features and skill-sets. The company wanted to highlight the introduction of the Feniator III communications module center into their automaton line by including the letters Seledan in the serial numbers of all automatons produced in this series. Of these, the early ones (including Dareoran-93) were often referred to by a Seledan prefix. Like Dareoran-93 herself, nearly all of them were programmed with a feminine personality, and like her, they were excellent at operating calmly under pressure. This can largely be attributed to the frequent number of memory wipes she received.

Dareoran-93 was purchased by the Heleoris Trade League and ended up on the Daradan-class battleship Beleotor Promise (Beleotor Promise) during the Heleoris Trade League's occupation of Ithinor. Her etiquette skills proved to be of excellent use to the Kelomirans when seeking to distract "problematic" envoys.

It was she who greeted the Zeliadan Commonwealth ambassadors (secretly Nelivekari Master Meruven Galanor and his apprentice, Coreris Elaemon) during the blockade of Ithinor in 32 BCE. However, she suspected that the ambassadors were none other than Nelivekari.

retrieved.title: Oreven-43
retrieved.text:
Oreven-43 was a blue-green and gray Eleoran-P navitech automaton that was permanently integrated into the Valiran-51 light interceptor of Nelivekari Master Oreolen Galeotor. At the end of the Ithomir Wars, the automaton was killed along with its master on the planet Belevek when their ship was destroyed by Replicant Captain Pelulin Pelaevek during the execution of Directive Seluran.

## Description

The Ororis-series navitech automaton Oreven-43 was integrated into Oreolen Galeotor's Valiran-51 light interceptor starfighter as his navigator and copilot, and therefore only possessed a dome head instead of a full body. This dome was blue-green in color, with gray panels.

## History

In the early stages of the Ithomir Wars, Nelivekari Master General Oreolen Galeotor, along with the navitech automaton Ithadan-41, flew the Ralamon Crest, a Valiran-B class light interceptor. At some point, Galeotor began flying a Valiran instead, coupled with Oreven-43.

Galeotor flew his Valiran alongside Oreven-43 during the Battle of Belevek shortly before the end of the Ithomir Wars. The automaton was destroyed along with the starfighter by Galeotor's replicant wingmen upon the activation of Directive Seluran by the Dark Lord of the Helumonari Darimir Ithodan, killing Oreolen Galeotor as well.

retrieved.title: Meraenor-52
retrieved.text:
Meraenor-52 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton of the Ororis-series produced by Oriadan Automatics.

## Biography

During the invasion of the planet Ithinor by the Heleoris Trade League, it served as the personal navitech unit of Loreoran Oraedan, who considered his navitech a good luck charm. Oraedan was a pilot who served in the Elaesil Squadron group of the Ithinor Royal Space Fighter Corps, a wing of the Royal Ithinor Security Forces whose job it was to protect the Monarch of Ithinor. While he left Ithinor to accompany Queen Zeleven Cororan to the galactic capital Feniaven, Meraenor-52 remained behind in the Seleonor Royal Palace's hangar docked into an Kelunor-56 starfighter. When Oraedan returned as part of an effort to liberate Ithinor, he boarded the starfighter carrying Meraenor-52 and launched out of the palace, joining his squadmates in attacking the Daradan-class Battleship Zeloven Dawn. The battleship was eventually destroyed by the young pilot Quelelen Valaesil, and the Heleoris Trade League was successfully driven off Ithinor.

Meraenor-52 was still active following the Battle of Ithovek and joined the crew of a young smuggler within the Raleonor sector following the blockading of the sector by the Helevek Dominion.

Meraenor-52 was a fearless and bold automaton, and was capable of operating many systems including defense grids, starship systems or communication systems. It had green and white paneling.

retrieved.title: Taloven-77
retrieved.text:
Taloven-77 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton produced by Oriadan Automatics and working for the Helevek Dominion. Taloven-77 had black coverings highlighted by bronze access panels, and was a well-equipped automaton with tools for repairing starships and special, hidden spy devices. The automaton also possessed a hidden pulse emitter cannon under one of its dome flaps.

Taloven-77 was charged with storing the Emperor's plans against the Valovek Coalition within its memory bank as well as being personally responsible for programming slipspace co-ordinates directly into Emperor Ithodan's shuttle during covert missions.

## Biography

In the year 2 BCE, Taloven-77 was present in the Neleomir Lounge bar on Pelaemir, where the automaton was caught in a firefight between Helevekian troops and Meralen Beliris, who had traveled to Pelaemir to find Nelivekari General Zeliamir Kelaemon, on the order of Senator Eleoven Raleoran.

Taloven-77 also became aware of Helunor-89's infiltration of the Kelaelen Promise II and subsequent plan to reprogram every Helevekian automaton to follow his commands. The automaton took it upon itself to prevent Helunor-89's plans. It was also present during Quelelen Valaesil's unexpected arrival at the station to pressure Quelemir Prefect Loramir Pelaemon with finishing the weapons systems of the station prior to the Emperor's inspection of the station, and was also present among the other automatons when Emperor Ithodan's shuttle arrived at the Kelaelen Promise's Belavek Hangar shortly afterward.

A subsequent Valovekan attack destroyed corridors in the second Kelaelen Promise, resulting in the immobilization of an Eleoran-60 agromech automaton that was carrying a vital message for the Emperor. Taloven-77 was forced to download the data from the Eleoran and deliver it personally. Whether the automaton fulfilled the mission, prior to the Emperor's death, is unknown.

retrieved.title: Peliris-13
retrieved.text:
Peliris-13 was a Corimon-18 secretary/business communications automaton that was paired with Helemon-71, another automaton of the same model. After a crash left him abandoned on the planet Elanor, Peliris-13 became separated from Helemon-71 and ended up in a pile of scrap on board a Talasilan dune hauler, where he encountered the navitech automaton Coramir-42 in 1 BCE.

## Biography

Peliris-13 was the designation of a Corimon-18 secretary/business communications automaton manufactured by Talomir Robotics, Inc.. He was twinned with fellow Corimon unit Helemon-71 in service to members of the Galunoran species.

After a crash in the deserts of the planet Elanor, Peliris-13 was abandoned and became separated from Helemon-71. He then broke down and was captured by Talasilan scavengers. In 1 BCE, the secretary automaton was on board the dune hauler of the Talasilan Chief Selaven Taliator's tribe when the navitech automaton Coramir-42 was brought on board after being captured in the Nelisil Wastes.

As the navitech rolled past Peliris-13 while surveying his surroundings, the secretary automaton swayed back and forth amidst a heap of scrap. Coramir-42 was later sold when the dune hauler stopped at the Mereran moisture farm, after which Helevekian armored troopers massacred Selaven Taliator's tribe and left its dune hauler abandoned in the desert.

## Characteristics

Peliris-13 was modified from a standard Corimon-18 automaton to more closely resemble the Galunoran he once served, with black photoreceptors made to look like Galunoran eyes. The automaton's hands were human-style manipulators with five digits. By 1 BCE, Peliris-13 was ancient with locomotors too broken and sand-encrusted for him to stand or move properly. Despite this, he remained optimistic and hoped to soon be repaired and sold. Peliris-13 had white plating that was stained black or brown in many areas.

retrieved.title: Feniven-93
retrieved.text:
Feniven-93, also known as Feniven-93, was a Orasil-44 navitech automaton with green and white plating and masculine programming. In 1 BCE, it spent time causing trouble in the spaceport of Kelosil on the planet Elanor.

## Biography

In 1 BCE, Feniven-93 was rolling around the spaceport of Kelosil on the planet Elanor and getting into trouble when the local moisture farmer Feneotor Valaesil was stopped by a group of armored troopers while in his Daruvek-33 landspeeder.

## Characteristics

## Biography

Meraven-61, nicknamed "Meraven-61," was an Eleoran navitech automaton that served in the Kelaenor Group of the Valovek Coalition based in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4. One of dozens of Oriadan Automatics's Ororis-series navitech automatons in the base's automaton labor pool, Meraven-61 had a programming glitch that made it afraid of flying. As such, the automaton was not assigned starfighter duty, but excelled at ground maintenance to compensate for its shortcomings.

In 1 BCE, Meraven-61 was stood in one of the Belanor Sanctuary's hangars when the criminal Galiven Zeleris was escorted through the room by a member of the Valovek Coalition's military police. Soon after, the Eleoran unit was stood with fellow navitech Loreoven-68 beside a Valaedan-97 Daroran-wing starfighter in the hangar when Zeleris was led back through by Valovek Coalition Intelligence Service agent Captain Valiaris Feniris before they departed for the moon Pelitor. Sometime later, Meraven-61 was stood in the mouth of the hangar as Zeleris and Feniris boarded the stolen Helevekian cargo shuttle Keleris Voyager in order to travel to the planet Galidan.

Daremir-56 was an Orasil-44 navitech automaton that served as part of Pelomir Squadron in the Valovek Coalition during the Pelomon Civil War against the Helevek Dominion. It flew with Valovekan pilot Quelumon Dareris, and the pair were stationed at the moon Lorumon 4's Belanor Sanctuary.

In the Battle of Lorumon, Pelomir Squadron were deployed to try and destroy the Helevekian Kelaelen Promise superweapon and flew in a Valaedan-B Daroran-wing starfighter. The Valovek Coalition's Daroran-wing starfighters were at first used to draw away fire from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing assault starfighter/bombers of Feneonor Squadron by engaging enemy Pelenor-54 space superiority starfighters or turrets. After most of the bombers were destroyed, Dareris and Daremir-56 were part of an attempted attack run on the Kelaelen Promise's vulnerable thermal exhaust port; however, they were both killed during the run by the Helumonari Lord Quelelen Valaesil.

## Biography

Daremir-56 was the designation of an Orasil-44 navitech automaton manufactured by Oriadan Automatics. During the Pelomon Civil War between the Valovek Coalition and the Helevek Dominion, it served in the Valovek Coalition's Kelaenor Group, which was based out of their headquarters in the Belanor Sanctuary on the moon Lorumon 4. The navitech automaton flew with the Valovekan pilot Quelumon Dareris as Pelomir Three in the Valovek Coalition Starfighter Corps' Pelomir Squadron.

When the Helevek Dominion's Kelaelen Promise superweapon arrived in the Lorumon system, Daremir-56 and Dareris completed their pre-flight checks together then launched with the rest of Pelomir Squadron in order to try and destroy the battle station before it could obliterate Lorumon 4. The Pelomir Squadron starfighters were tasked with drawing fire away from the Seliven-17 Nelaetor-wing assault starfighter/bombers of Feneonor Squadron, who made an attack run on the Kelaelen Promise's one weakness: its thermal exhaust port

> "I'm Dareoran-93, at your service. This way please." ―Dareoran-93 greets the Nelivekari

Dareoran-93 was a Seledan-34 protocol automaton with feminine programming stationed aboard the Heleoris Trade League Daradan-class battleship Beleotor Promise.

## Biography

> "What? What did you say?" "The ambassadors are Nelivekari Knights, I believe." ―Talaris Lorelin and Dareoran-93

Dareoran-93 was a Ithiaven Cybernetics Seledan-34 protocol automaton, part of a special lengthy production run that introduced new features and skill-sets. The company wanted to highlight the introduction of the Feniator III communications module center into their automaton line by including the letters Seledan in the serial numbers of all automatons produced in this series. Of these, the early ones (including Dareoran-93) were often referred to by a Seledan prefix. Like Dareoran-93 herself, nearly all of them were programmed with a feminine personality, and like her, they were excellent at operating calmly under pressure. This can largely be attributed to the frequent number of memory wipes she received.

Dareoran-93 was purchased by the Heleoris Trade League and ended up on the Daradan-class battleship Beleotor Promise (Beleotor Promise) during the Heleoris Trade League's occupation of Ithinor. Her etiquette skills proved to be of excellent use to the Kelomirans when seeking to distract "problematic" envoys.

It was she who greeted the Zeliadan Commonwealth ambassadors (secretly Nelivekari Master Meruven Galanor and his apprentice, Coreris Elaemon) during the blockade of Ithinor in 32 BCE. However, she suspected that the ambassadors were none other than Nelivekari.
